reviewed_sources.title: CrossBFM: Distilling a Shared Latent Behavior Space Across Humanoid Embodiments

reviewed_sources.notes: Separate distributional safety critic prioritizes contexts and reuses environment event realizations. PPO policy loss and task reward remain fixed. This is not arbitrary off-policy trajectory replay. ANYmal-D/X quadrupeds; omitted safety costs remain a limitation.
reviewed_sources.asset_status: No training code or weight entry identified in the checked original paper; external channels not exhaustively searched.
